Pacera Launchpad: design handoff

Specification for engineering. Covers the sign-in flow and every Launchpad screen, with measurements, tokens, states, behaviour and accessibility. Values come from the built prototype pacera-launchpad.html, measured at 1440 x 900.

Product Pacera suite, LaunchpadOwner Helmy Alshaar, UX LeadStatus Ready for buildPrototype pacera-launchpad.htmlCompanion design-system.html, icons.html

What Launchpad is

Launchpad is the suite-level application. It does four jobs: (1) data integration between FP&A, Consolidation, Close and Lease, run by ORA; (2) cross-app analysis; (3) suite-level settings and control; (4) a productivity hub for work items, discussion and approvals, "like Jira for B2B finance". It is the first screen after sign-in and the only app that shows data from more than one application.

In scope

  • Single-entry sign-in, MFA, SSO, reset
  • Home, Work board, Threads, Data flows, Analysis, Approvals
  • Suite settings, personal settings, app design
  • Shared shell: header, rails, level 2 panel, ORA panel, footer, suite switcher

Out of scope

  • Workspaces of the four apps (separate handoffs)
  • Real ORA model behaviour (replies in the prototype are scripted)
  • Mobile layout below 800px (read only, see Responsive)
Data origin is the core rule. Every card, badge and chart carries a data origin: one app (blue), ORA (turquoise) or across apps (purple, Launchpad). Do not ship a number without an origin.
Prototype data is illustrative. Names, amounts and ORA replies are sample content. The numbers do reconcile across apps (see Data and provenance), and engineers should keep that rule when wiring real data.

Sign-in

A single entry for the whole suite. The user arrives from the brand website, signs in once and lands on Launchpad. Other apps open from the suite switcher without a second sign-in.

Layout

  • Two panels. Left brand panel 50% width, right form panel 50%.
  • Brand panel: midnight to purple gradient, concentric wave graphic, white wordmark top left, headline "Time to Power Up" with "Power Up" in --eggshell.
  • Form card max width 400px, centred vertically.
  • Below 900px: brand panel hides, form fills the screen.

Flow

  1. Work email → Continue, or Continue with single sign-on
  2. Password (+ Keep me signed in, Forgot password)
  3. 6-digit code (MFA) with Trust this device
  4. Success → Launchpad. Session stored under pacera.session.
StepFieldValidationError copy
1Work emailRequired. Pattern name@domain.tld.Empty: "Enter your work email address." Invalid: "Enter a valid work email address, for example name@company.com."
2PasswordRequired. Minimum 8 characters.Empty: "Enter your password." Wrong: "The email or password is incorrect. Try again or reset your password."
3Code6 digits, numbers only. Auto advance, paste splits across boxes, backspace moves back. Submit when full."Enter all 6 digits of your code."
ResetWork emailSame as step 1. Always shows the same confirmation.Confirmation: "If an account exists for this email, you will receive a reset link within a few minutes. The link expires in 30 minutes."

States

  • Default: input border --border-strong, radius 8, height 40.
  • Focus: 2px accent ring, no layout shift.
  • Error: border --bad, message with 14px alert icon, role="alert", aria-invalid="true" on the input.
  • Loading: 28px spinner, heading "Signing you in", text "Loading your workspace…". Form is replaced, not disabled.
  • SSO: "Redirecting to your identity provider". Returns here after the provider responds.
  • Lockout (to build): after 5 failed attempts show "Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes or reset your password." Disable submit.
Security notes for engineering: never reveal whether an email exists (reset confirmation is identical). Do not store passwords or codes in client storage. The prototype stores only a flag.

Work board

One board for tasks from every app, plus ORA suggestions. Think Jira, for finance work.

  • Columns: Backlog, In progress, In review, Done. Each header shows a count. Column background --surface-2, radius 12.
  • Card: title (13px, max 3 lines), origin badge(s), priority icon, assignee avatars (max 3, then +n), due date with calendar icon, move action "{next column} →".
  • Origin: left border of the card. Suite items (purple) show which apps they touch. ORA-drafted items carry a turquoise "ORA drafted" badge.
  • Move: button moves one column right and shows toast "Moved to {column}". To build: drag and drop with keyboard alternative (Space to pick up, arrows to move, Space to drop).
  • Priority icons: priority-high, priority-med, priority-low. Always paired with an accessible name.
StateBehaviour
Empty columnDashed outline, text "Nothing here yet." and, in Backlog, a New item button
LoadingThree skeleton cards per column
Card hoverBorder --border-strong, shadow-2
Card focusFocus ring, whole card is one tab stop, Enter opens the item
Done columnTitle in --text-2, no move button

Threads

Team discussion where the data lives. A reply can embed a live number, chart or work item, and keeps its origin.

  • List pane: 320px. Unread dot (7px, --accent), title (600 when unread), author, time, reply count.
  • Thread pane: header with title and status badge, messages, composer pinned to the bottom.
  • Message: 28px avatar, name 600, time, body, optional embeds. Embeds have a left border in origin colour and an origin badge.
  • Mentions: @name in --purple-ink on --purple-bg. Typing @ opens a people and objects picker.
  • Embed types: live value (updates on view), chart snapshot, work item card, ORA finding.
  • Composer: textarea 2 rows growing to 8, attach live chart, mention, Reply button. Ctrl Enter sends.
Embedded numbers are live. If the source changes after a reply, show "Updated since posted" with the old value on hover. This is to build.

Data flows

Shows how data moves from source systems through ORA into the apps and Launchpad, with the run history of each workflow.

  • Map: SVG, viewBox 900 x 380, scales to the card width. Source systems left, ORA column in the centre, apps right, Launchpad far right. Teal lines are moved by ORA, blue dashed lines are direct app to app, purple lines are published to Launchpad.
  • Text alternative: the SVG has role="img" and a label. Provide the same information as a table for screen readers (workflow runs table below the map).
  • Run table columns: Workflow, Route, Rows, Data quality (bar plus percent), Status, Last run.
  • Quality bar: green at 97% and above, orange below.
  • Status values: Succeeded (green), Running (turquoise), Needs review (orange), Failed (red).

Cross-app analysis

Group results combined from Close, Consolidation and FP&A. The page explains how each number was made.

  • Main chart: monthly EBITDA. Budget dashed grey, actual solid purple with area, ORA forecast dashed turquoise with a shaded confidence band from October.
  • Lineage card: lists every input to the headline number, in order, with an origin badge each. Last row is the ORA estimate for open items with its confidence.
  • Metric switch: EBITDA, Revenue, Cash. Changes the main chart and the lineage list.
  • Export: CSV of the series and a PNG of the chart. Both include origin per series.

Accessibility

Target: WCAG 2.2 AA.

Landmarks and order

header (banner) → nav suite switcher → nav main menu → aside level 2 → main (with toolbar role) → aside right panel → nav right rail → footer. Tab order follows this order. Skip link "Skip to main content" is the first focusable element.

ElementRole / ARIAKeyboard
App iconbutton, aria-expanded, label "Open application switcher"Enter, Space
Rail buttonsbutton, aria-pressed, label from tooltipArrow up and down move between items. Enter opens
Tabstablist / tab / tabpanel, aria-selectedArrow left and right. Delete closes
L2 expandable itembutton with aria-expandedRight arrow expands, left collapses
Workspace toolbarrole="toolbar", label "Workspace tools"Roving tabindex, arrows
Origin filterbutton aria-pressedSpace toggles
KanbanColumns as region with count in label. Cards as articleKeyboard move as described in Work board
Chartsrole="img" with a label that states the key finding. Data table availableFocusable points show tooltip
Toastrole="status", aria-live="polite"Not focusable
Form errorrole="alert" and aria-invalid, linked with aria-describedbyFocus moves to first invalid field on submit
ORA messagesLive region polite. Origin chips are links with namesTab through sources
  • Minimum contrast: 4.5:1 body text, 3:1 large text and UI. The design system page lists measured ratios for every pair.
  • All three origin colours stay distinguishable under protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia. Origin is also carried by icon and text.
  • Targets: 32px minimum (rail items 48 x 44).
  • Focus ring is always visible: 2px accent with 2px offset.
  • Do not trap focus except in dialogs. Return focus to the trigger on close.

Data and provenance

What the front end needs from the back end.

Provenance model

Every datum that appears in a card, chart series, table cell or embed has:

{
  "value": 17.3,
  "unit": "EUR_m",
  "origin": "app | ora | suite",
  "sources": [{"app": "close", "label": "Close", "asOf": "2026-11-04T14:02:00Z"}],
  "confidence": 0.94,        // only when origin includes ora
  "confirmedBy": null         // user id when a person confirmed an ORA value
}
  • origin = suite when sources include more than one app. Badge label lists them ("Close + Consolidation").
  • origin = ora when any part of the value is estimated or generated. When a user confirms or overrides it, origin changes to the owning app and confirmedBy is set.
  • The badge, card border and chart series colour are derived from origin. Do not hard code them.

Reconciliation rule

One set of numbers feeds the whole suite. October group EBITDA is the same value in Launchpad Home, Cross-app analysis, FP&A, Consolidation and Close. A Launchpad figure is never computed independently of the app that owns it.

WidgetEndpoint (suggested)Refresh
KPI rowGET /suite/kpis?period=On load and every 5 min
App healthGET /suite/apps/healthEvery 60 s
Work boardGET /work/items, PATCH /work/items/{id}On load, push updates
ThreadsGET /threads, POST /threads/{id}/messagesPush (websocket)
Data flowsGET /integrations/flows, GET /integrations/runsEvery 30 s while page is open
AnalysisGET /analysis/series?metric=&period=, GET /analysis/lineage?metric=On change
ORA chatPOST /ora/messages (stream)Stream

QA and open questions

Acceptance checklist

  • Frame sizes match the Frame table at 1440 and at 1100
  • Header, rails and footer identical to the other four apps
  • Every number has an origin badge, border and tooltip
  • Light and dark pass contrast on all text and UI
  • Origin colours distinguishable in a colour-blind simulator
  • All flows work with keyboard only
  • Screen reader announces errors, toasts and ORA replies
  • Charts redraw on resize and theme change
  • Suite switcher opens apps in new tabs and keeps the session
  • Strings match the copy deck, with no truncation at 140% text length
  • Reduced motion respected

Open questions

  • Drag and drop on the board: library choice and keyboard pattern.
  • Real-time updates for embeds in threads: websocket or polling?
  • Max size for attached data in a thread (suggest 25 MB).
  • Single sign-on providers for launch (Entra ID and Okta suggested).
  • Does a locked period hide the Review button on approvals?
  • Retention period for message boards and audit trail.

Known gaps in the prototype

  • ORA replies are scripted and sources are static.
  • The board moves cards one column forward only.
  • No lockout, offline or session-expiry screens yet. Specified above.
  • Pages for Connectors, Run history, Data quality, Lineage, KPI library, Audit trail and Permissions use a generic register layout.
